_note: sorcmerc-authored mechanics for wearable data/magic-items.json ids (the export is prose only, structuredBonuses null on every entry). An item listed here does something on the sheet while it is in a hero's `equipped` list; an unlisted one is carried, worn and sold, and does nothing in a fight. core/rules/pass_items.gd reads it. `slot`: weapon (rides the weapon in hand: every weapon attack but the off-hand one), armor (needs body armor worn), shield (is a shield: counts as armor.json's shield, plus its own bonus), worn (no condition). Keys: attack / damage (weapon attacks; `weapons` narrows them to those weapon ids), ac (`unarmored`: only with no body armor and no shield), saves (all six), checks (skills and initiative), set_ability ({ability: score}, raises a lower score to it), spell_attack, resist (damage types). One of each id counts, the best of each weapon/armor/shield slot counts, and at most three items that need attunement count (magic-items.json's `attunement`), in the order they were put on. `text` is the line the sheet and the tooltip show.

weapon-1.text: +1 to attack and damage with the weapon in hand

weapon-2.text: +2 to attack and damage with the weapon in hand

weapon-3.text: +3 to attack and damage with the weapon in hand

shield-1.text: A shield: +1 AC on top of the shield's own +2

shield-2.text: A shield: +2 AC on top of the shield's own +2

shield-3.text: A shield: +3 AC on top of the shield's own +2

cloak-of-protection.text: +1 AC and +1 to every saving throw

ring-of-protection.text: +1 AC and +1 to every saving throw

stone-of-good-luck-(luckstone).text: +1 to every saving throw and ability check

bracers-of-defense.text: +2 AC with no armor and no shield

bracers-of-archery.text: +2 damage with a longbow or shortbow
